levels.label: Complete
levels.descriptor: An entry exists for every session of the unit: each of the five station days, the planning work, and the measuring.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: One session of the unit has no entry.

levels.label: Developing
levels.descriptor: Two or three sessions have no entry.

levels.label: Absent
levels.descriptor: Four or more sessions have no entry, or no pages were uploaded.

criterion: How you kept your notebook: Every session in the unit has an entry

levels.label: Complete
levels.descriptor: Numbers and notes appear as they were taken, with corrections and crossed-out readings left visible.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: Most entries read as recorded; one or two look copied over.

levels.label: Developing
levels.descriptor: Most entries look rewritten or cleaned up after the fact.

levels.label: Absent
levels.descriptor: No raw numbers or in-progress notes appear anywhere.

criterion: How you kept your notebook: Written at the machine, not copied out later

levels.label: Complete
levels.descriptor: Every entry carries its date and the handwriting can be read. Photo quality is scored on the Capture, not here.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: One or two entries are undated, or one or two pages are hard to read as written.

levels.label: Developing
levels.descriptor: Three or four entries are undated or hard to read as written.

levels.label: Absent
levels.descriptor: Most entries carry no date, or most pages cannot be read as written.

criterion: How you kept your notebook: Dated, and written so it can be read

levels.label: Complete
levels.descriptor: Taken together the pages let another student repeat the unit: plan, make, measure. What any single station record contains is scored on the Capture, not here.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: One session would need a question answered before it could be repeated.

levels.label: Developing
levels.descriptor: Two or three sessions could not be repeated from the pages alone.

levels.label: Absent
levels.descriptor: The pages record that work happened without recording what was done.

criterion: How you kept your notebook: A notebook someone else could work from
